description: A one-tap VFX on one shot: dusk (day to twilight), staging_fill (an empty room furnishes itself; interiors only), seasons (season_from current or a season, season_to summer, fall, winter or spring), shadows (a sun time lapse), stars (a starry night), sign_drop (3D letters drop onto the lawn: sign_text is a preset such as For Sale, Just Listed, Open House or Sold, or up to 2 words and 16 characters; default For Sale), helicopter_reveal (a helicopter lifts a cover off the home), sketch_to_real (a pencil sketch becomes the photo), house_drop (a construction time lapse) or people (a couple placed in the scene). The finished clip replaces the shot's clip, with Undo, after a few minutes. suggest_direction picks a VFX and shot for a wish; browse_options vfx lists them all. Uses 1 AI+ credit. On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.

conceptConsent.description: true only after the person said this is for builder or concept marketing (needed for concept VFX).

effect.description: Which VFX; browse_options vfx describes each.

photoId.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".

season_from.description: For seasons: the season the photo shows now, or current.

season_to.description: For seasons: the season to change to.

sign_text.description: For sign_drop: the sign's words, a preset like 'For Sale' or up to 2 words and 16 characters.
